kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِسْتَقْبَلَ • (istaqbala) X (non-past يَسْتَقْبِلُ (yastaqbilu), verbal noun اِسْتِقْبَال (istiqbāl))
g: to receive (a person, radio broadcast, etc.)
to go to meet, to meet
to place oneself in front of, opposite to (transitive)
to take upon oneself, to assume
